source.sourcesTrustedBecause: Primary upstream GitHub repository at immutable commit SHA plus official shadcn-svelte documentation domain. Inventory extracted from pinned source tarball; no third-party mirrors.

counts.publicComponentCountRule: Count distinct exported Svelte component bindings in each family barrel once. For a given binding, exports such as Root and Root as Accordion are one component. Keep runtimeExportNames/aliases available for exact import surface; exclude typeExports and helperRuntimeExports. Catalog-item count is a separate 66-family/page count.
counts.directSourceComponentExportCountExcludes: Alternate barrel aliases for the same binding; type-only exports; runtime helpers such as *Variants and useSidebar; registry family/page counts are separate.

catalogItems.title: Combobox
catalogItems.classificationEvidence: Guide/recipe only: composed from Popover + Command; no standalone registry UI family.

catalogItems.title: Data Table
catalogItems.classificationEvidence: Guide/recipe only: uses Table and TanStack Table; no standalone registry UI family.

catalogItems.title: Date Picker
catalogItems.classificationEvidence: Guide/recipe only: composed from Popover + Calendar or RangeCalendar; no standalone registry UI family.

catalogItems.title: Typography
catalogItems.classificationEvidence: Catalog docs page but no docs/src/lib/registry/ui/typography directory; style/typography documentation rather than installable source family.

form.whyExcluded: There is no docs/content/components/form.md, so the official component catalog generated from docs content omits it. However, docs/scripts/registry.ts crawlUI() enumerates every docs/src/lib/registry/ui directory, so the registry builder still emits a registry:ui item named form. The source index imports formsnap. Treat as non-catalog registry artifact, not as proof Form is in the supported 66-component catalog.
form.replacementEvidence: The current catalog has a Field family page and direct-source family at docs/content/components/field.md and docs/src/lib/registry/ui/field; no explicit upstream statement in the inspected pinned source declares Form deprecated.

registryVsCatalog.registryBehavior: The pinned registry builder recursively crawls ui, examples, blocks, hooks, lib, fonts; crawlUI creates a registry:ui item for each UI directory. buildUIRegistry tracks source files and internal registryDependencies inferred from $lib imports; the CLI schema also allows npm dependencies and files.
registryVsCatalog.catalogBehavior: The docs component list uses content docs and excludes only the Components index page; therefore direct source-directory presence alone does not define the public catalog.

integrationAndBuildImplications.distributionModel: Official intro says shadcn-svelte supplies actual source code; CLI copies source into the consumer project for customization. Treat upstream as source/registry input, not a prebuilt component runtime package.
integrationAndBuildImplications.globalStyling: Components rely on Tailwind utility classes and semantic CSS theme variables. Installation config includes style, aliases, Tailwind CSS path, and configurable iconLibrary; source aliases must be resolved per consumer project.
integrationAndBuildImplications.dependencyExtractionLimit: Per-item externalRuntimeDependencies records direct bare-package imports found in that family source folder. Dependencies imported by shared $lib utilities/config are not attributed to each family; exact project bootstrap and transitive resolution also depend on CLI style/config and package manager.
integrationAndBuildImplications.docsPackageDeclaredRanges: externalRuntimeDependencyRanges copies ranges from docs/package.json at the same pinned commit; this is upstream docs app declaration evidence, not a universal minimum or lockfile-resolved version.

reproducibility: Download the GitHub source archive at commit fe4b0ad3b8b30c6745346db008c3307b5afeabb1 and rerun extraction; do not use mutable latest/main for an immutable plan snapshot.

viewstemPlan.baseline: Official Components catalog at pinned commit; separate AI Elements/blocks and non-catalog Form are not included
